method: Independent sealed-source audit plus isolated exact-source replay of the 21-condition fit audit, 24-condition specification audit, and 10-condition motion manifest covering two-way reel clearance, four latch entry corridors, shell capture, stand arc, and both endpoint stops.
acceptance: All 21 shared nominal-fit checks and all 24 specification checks must pass from an isolated copy of the sealed source.
Clockwise and counterclockwise hard-part reel cycles must each clear 73 samples; all four latch lead paths must clear; retained shell pullout must block separately.
The stand must implement the authored 112-degree endpoint, clear 57 arc samples, block both overtravel directions, and remain within the authored about-82-mm depth target.
Rigid and algebraic checks must not be represented as proof of elastic force, strain, detent feel, snap retention, tipping, strength, printed fit, or cycle life.
